# Torra Gips

> Torra Gips is a professional interior-finishing contractor based in Tirana, Albania, serving Tirana and Durrës. We provide gypsum works (punime gipsi), wall plastering (patinim) and painting (lyerje) for residential and commercial projects. 100+ completed projects including Vlora International Airport, Green Coast Resort, Rolling Hills and Lion Park. We use Knauf and Rigips gypsum systems and Dulux, Jotun and Caparol paints. Free on-site consultation. Phone/WhatsApp: +355 68 858 0058. Email: torragips@gmail.com. Hours: Mon–Sat 08:00–18:00.

## Services
- [Gypsum Works](https://www.torragips.com/en/gypsum-works/): Suspended ceilings, space partitions, architectural decorations and acoustic/thermal insulation.
- [Wall Plastering](https://www.torragips.com/en/wall-plastering/): Interior and exterior plastering, decorative plaster (Venetian/stucco), wall repairs and restorations.
- [Painting](https://www.torragips.com/en/painting/): Interior and exterior painting, decorative effects and durable finishes.
- [Pricing](https://www.torragips.com/en/pricing/): Indicative prices per m² (in Lek) for gypsum cladding, partition walls, suspended ceilings and finishing.
